title: Makefiles and task runners
description: Conventions for Makefiles and task runners.

rules.title: Declare .PHONY
rules.text: Mark targets that are not files as .PHONY.

rules.title: Self-documenting help
rules.text: Provide a default help target that lists the available commands with one-line descriptions.

rules.title: Keep recipes thin
rules.text: Keep recipes short and delegate real logic to scripts or the language tooling.

rules.title: Tabs in recipes
rules.text: Indent recipe lines with tabs, as make requires, even if the rest of the repository uses spaces.

rules.title: Variables for tools
rules.text: Put tool names and flags in variables that can be overridden from the environment.
